caseStudies.title: Vertical Academy
caseStudies.summary: Curriculum and course design for an online learning academy.
caseStudies.description: Designed and developed curriculum and instructional content for Vertical Academy, an online learning platform. The work included needs analysis, learning objective writing, storyboarding, and building interactive course content aligned to learner outcomes.
highlights: Conducted needs analysis to define learning objectives
Designed and structured course curriculum from the ground up
Built interactive course content aligned to learner outcomes

caseStudies.title: Manns and Associates
caseStudies.summary: Full LMS implementation and course deployment for Manns and Associates.
caseStudies.description: Led the implementation of a learning management system for Manns and Associates, enabling the organization to deliver and track training programs at scale. The project included platform configuration, content migration, and training staff on LMS administration.
highlights: Configured and launched the LMS platform from scratch
Migrated and organized existing training content into the new system
Trained staff on LMS administration and reporting

caseStudies.title: Health and Safety Experts
caseStudies.summary: Health and safety compliance courses designed for workplace training.
caseStudies.description: Designed and developed health and safety e-learning courses for Health and Safety Experts. The courses cover workplace compliance, hazard identification, and safety protocols, using scenario-based learning to engage learners and reinforce real-world application.
caseStudies.impact: Compliance training delivered across the organization
highlights: Designed scenario-based health and safety courses
Covered hazard identification, risk assessment, and workplace compliance
Built training that meets regulatory safety standards

caseStudies.title: Abitare Life
caseStudies.summary: Lead Care Manager core curriculum developed for Abitare Life's Enhanced Care Management programme.
caseStudies.description: Designed and developed the Lead Care Manager (LCM) Core Curriculum for Abitare Life, a care management organisation. The 10-module Rise 360 course covers Enhanced Care Management (ECM), ethics, HIPAA, home visit fundamentals, member engagement, community supports, documentation standards, and scenario-based practice - giving LCMs a structured, compliance-aligned onboarding experience.
highlights: Built 10-module LCM Core Curriculum covering ECM, ethics, HIPAA, and home visits
Designed scenario-based practice modules for real-world application
Structured content to meet Medi-Cal compliance and documentation standards

caseStudies.title: Realtors One Voice One Vote
caseStudies.summary: Educational content and training program for a real estate advocacy initiative.
caseStudies.description: Created educational content and training materials for Realtors One Voice One Vote, an advocacy initiative within the real estate sector. The work involved designing a curriculum that educates realtors on civic engagement, voting rights, and advocacy strategies, making the content both informative and motivating.
caseStudies.impact: Training program launched for realtor community
highlights: Designed educational content focused on civic engagement and advocacy
Built training materials tailored to the realtor community

caseStudies.title: Deel Engage
caseStudies.summary: Microlearning modules built inside Deel Engage to train people leaders on performance review workflows.
caseStudies.description: Designed and developed microlearning content within Deel Engage - a global HR and performance management platform - to help people leaders navigate performance review cycles. The modules cover team views, extended view options, review cycles, and goal-setting workflows, making complex platform features accessible and easy to apply on the job.
caseStudies.impact: Microlearning suite delivered for people leaders globally
highlights: Developed microlearning modules for Deel Engage's performance review module
Covered team view, extended view, and review cycle navigation
Designed concise, action-oriented content for global people leaders
